name: Melorra Catalog API
description: Public API for Melorra's product catalog and jewellery services. All endpoints are served from the catalog backend.

pagination.description: All list responses are paginated. The response object contains 'count', 'next', 'previous', and 'results'. The actual data is always inside the 'results' field.

endpoints.description: List all jewellery products. Supports multiple filters.

parameters.set_name: Filter by collection set name, e.g., 'Sea Shell'

endpoints.description: Get detailed information about a product using its SKU.
